title: ModelImprovementPlan
description: The Research Director's deliverable: a critic-hardened, prioritized set of changes to an EXISTING model, derived from diagnosing the patterns in its results. Each change targets a named failure mode with tier-tagged evidence and an expected effect on a specific metric. The single `top_recommendation` is auto-validated (trained+scored vs the baseline) when it is expressible as a training run; broader changes (new-data acquisition, new model code) carry a `validation_method` and hand off. 'RD proposes, the search controller + the human dispose.'

dominant_failure_modes.description: Where the existing model underperforms, each anchored to a specific result artifact (a confusion-matrix cell, a per-class F1, a mined outcome pattern, an integrated-gradients finding).

metric_impact.description: How this failure mode costs the binding objective metric.

top_recommendation.description: The `id` of the single highest-leverage change — the one auto-validated in the validation stage (if auto_validatable) or flagged for priority handoff otherwise.

tier.description: T3 proven-live > T2 internal-experimental (incl. THIS model's own results) > T1 external literature.

source_ref.description: A publication id/URL, a training_result key path (e.g. 'confusion_matrix[BIG_UP->FLAT]', 'test_f1_per_class.FLAT'), an outcome-pattern id, an mlflow_run_id, or a journal ref.

scope.description: The KIND of change — arbitrary scope is allowed: a feature edit, adding a correlated symbol, an overlay/auxiliary model run in conjunction, a loss/penalty change, a label redesign, a hyperparameter regime, an ensemble, a new architecture, or a data acquisition.

mechanism.description: WHY this change fixes the failure mode — the causal argument, not a restatement.

feasibility.description: What it takes to implement — and why it is (or isn't) buildable/trainable today.

auto_validatable.description: True iff this change can be trained+scored today by the search controller over the objective's walk-forward folds (requires a catalog family). False for new-data acquisition or new model code.

validation_method.description: REQUIRED when auto_validatable=false: how a human/downstream would validate (data acquisition + re-eval, code implementation + backtest, etc.).

executable_candidate.description: One candidate in ManualCandidatesSpec shape (config/manual_candidates.schema.json) — dropped straight into a manual_spec for the search controller with no translation. features MUST be exactly one of view | prefixes | columns (no extra keys).

ensembles.description: Set true only when scope is ensemble/overlay_model and the Stage-2 ensemble layer should run.

feature_selection.description: Exactly ONE of view / prefixes / columns — mirrors config/schemas/manual_candidates.schema.json. Extra keys (context_view, note, meta_inputs, …) are invalid.

prefixes.description: Keep columns whose names start with any of these prefixes (e.g. ['vw_', 'rv_', 'of_']).

columns.description: Exact feature column names only — not group prefixes.
